# Emmaus: Walk with God

> Emmaus is an iPhone Bible and discipleship app from Disciple Maker, LLC. Read the whole Bible one chapter a day with no streaks, keep a private prayer journal, and walk with a friend.

## App

- [Website](https://getemmaus.app/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6788956467)

## Key pages

- [Privacy Policy](https://getemmaus.app/privacy/)
- [Support](https://getemmaus.app/support/)
- [Terms of Use](https://getemmaus.app/terms/)

## Pricing

- [Emmaus Premium plans and trial](https://getemmaus.app/#pricing): Free download; monthly and annual plans. Apple shows trial eligibility and billing terms before confirmation.
